segments.name: Commercial
segments.description: Owns and manages income-producing commercial real estate, mostly office buildings, earning rental and property income.
segments.evidence: We operate as two primary operating and reportable segments: (i) commercial and (ii) residential.

segments.name: Residential
segments.description: Develops and owns multi-family residential properties on the West Coast, earning rental income.
segments.evidence: Effective January 1, 2026, the Company reorganized its real estate operations by separating its multi-family residential portfolio from its commercial real estate investments.

revenueModel.text: Rental and other property income from the commercial and residential real estate the company owns and operates.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's segments derive revenue primarily from rental and other property income.

changes.text: In 2026 the company reorganized into commercial and residential reportable segments, with prior periods recast.
changes.evidence: As a result, the Company changed its segment reporting structure and now presents two reportable segments: (i) commercial and (ii) residential.
